This year, we have amped up our partnership to secure even better benefits for TechBBQ participants, a huge pre-party, and side-events at Matrikel1 – Join us! Join the Pre-party Uniting the Ecosystem Situated in the heart of Copenhagen, Matrikel1 is the central hub for startups, investors, and ecosystem players like TechBBQ. Founded by Mesh Community in 2018, Matrikel1 benefits from being one of four Nordic hubs with: 250,000 yearly visitors 100,000 social media followers 5,000 members 1,700 yearly events Busses, passes, & benefits for TechBBQ participants For this year’s TechBBQ we will have buses to and from the TechBBQ venue, badge pick-up, and special deals for ticket-holders at Matrikel1 both days. In other words, Matrikel1 will be the natural meeting point and perfect spot to host your meetups, receptions, dinners, and side-events during TechBBQ. Reach out to Aya at
This time, we invite 150 founders and investors to explore the state of the Nordic VC scene to kick off TechBBQ in the best way possible.
September 12 : Funding in Tough Times Location : TechBBQ, Garden Stage Time : 12:30 PM It’s not 2019 anymore and the funding in Europe – so how do you fundraise in this climate?
Get the latest data on fundraising in the Nordics, explore alternative loan opportunities, and hear how Hans Augusenborg, co-founder of Birdie, raised $500.000 on Kickstarter in 30 days.
